item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 13/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry continental airstream will bring persistently very hot and fine weather to southern China this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Muifa will move across the vicinity of the East China Sea and edge closer to the coast of eastern China in the next couple of days. The area of low pressure to the southwest of Iwo Jima will develop into a tropical cyclone gradually and move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
